rubrics.justification: Describes a high-quality expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the provided 3AA/expanded description. Minor issue: it questions the 3AA vs 4AA label without image-confirmable necessity.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometriosis, BMI, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status into prognosis and transfer planning.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient modifiers. Small limitation: some speculative fresh-transfer considerations (OHSS/progesterone rise) are introduced without direct data.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with eSET, cautious use of add-ons, and selective PGT-A. Slight overreach in discussing prolonged GnRH suppression as a future option without stronger case-specific indication.
Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer, luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, embryo cryopreservation, and future evaluation if failures occur, with appropriate nuance.
